evidence: The user's answers in the coordination-shells interview, 2026-10-24. (8) A firm rule: every CN or angle in an answer carries its window in Angstrom; an answer that gives one without it gets a warning under it. Until now no check read it, and the coordination check took any window in Angstrom as a partial shell, so an answer that stated its window, as the rule asks, was never checked against the whole shell. (1) The window defaults to find_gr_peaks' first shell, cross-checked against the average structure's bond lengths; flag when the two disagree by more than the shell's width. No tool reported an A-B bond length of the average structure (the context's pair_correlations gives the shortest only). Taken as: the average structure's first shell for the pair, every distance between the pair's site means (the basis frac, the 26 neighbouring cells, the full cell metric) from the shortest to 0.5 A beyond it (the join's reach, SPLIT_SHELL_REACH_A: a distorted polyhedron's bond lengths lie within it), not each site's nearest partner: the Demo's second Se site has no Ga neighbour, and its nearest Ga, 4.26 A away, would read as a Ga-Se bond 1.48 A outside the 2.18-2.79 A shell. The two disagree when a bond lies outside first_shell.window_A by more than the shell's width, its first peak's FWHM: the window runs from the 1 % onset to the closing minimum, so a bond outside it lies where the configuration has almost no pairs; one FWHM is the shell's own spread, more than any offset of a site mean from the local bonds; the window's own width (0.46-1.40 A on the Demo and the dev cases) would pass the fifth bond of a 4 + 1 polyhedron whose shell closes before it, the case the check exists for (a CuF5 pyramid, 4 x 1.93 + 2.40 A: the fifth bond 0.23 A past the closing minimum against a 0.12 A FWHM, flagged); and the FWHM's overestimate on overlapping peaks errs towards silence. On the Demo and every dev case no pair disagrees (the Demo's Ga-Se 2.42-2.44 A in 2.18-2.79 A, Ta-Se 2.52-2.76 A in 2.21-3.23 A, Ta-Ta 3.02-3.07 A in 2.65-3.33 A, Se-Se 3.35-3.69 A in 3.02-4.42 A; dev-jahn-teller's Cu-F 2.01-2.05 A in 1.70-2.52 A). (7) Corner-sharing or extended networks use angle spreads plus a polyhedral distortion index, never the cluster null; with the coordinator's two additions (2026-10-24, from the polyhedral_distortion builder): the evidence gate backed distorted octahedra or polyhedra with analyze_clusters only, so an answer after polyhedral_distortion alone was sent back for analyze_clusters, and analyze_clusters' method said 'cluster or polyhedron distortion'. Known answers: answerChecks.test.js (the window check: seven unwindowed numbers flagged, twelve windowed, ideal, negated, direction or hypothetical ones left; the coordination check on a stated whole-shell window and on 'n A per B'), verification.test.js (the polyhedra row with and without polyhedral_distortion offered; anyOf asking for the first offered analysis), shells.test.js and runTools.test.js (the average structure's first shell and the cross-check: the pyramid flagged, the square not, no basis no check), copilotTools.test.js (analyze_clusters' method with and without the tool). On the answer corpus (ten real answers) the changes raise no new finding and no send-back: the README GIF's GaSe4 answer states its window for the Ga-Se pair, which carries its angles. Three scripted replays changed with the rule (their answers now carry the window, or expect the window finding: the README GIF's bare answer, the spot check's 'four-coordinated'), and three new replays pin answers 8, 1 and 7 on the Demo. Arms A, A+ and D on the dev set before and after: all 45 records identical in verdict, score and readings. Approved by the user, 2026-10-24.
proposed_fix: Implemented as the user answered. The window check (src/llm/copilot/verification/facts.js windowRule, in the coordination row after the coordination rule): a coordination number (CN_CLAIMS, NEIGHBOUR_COUNTS: 'n-coordinated', 'CN n', 'n A per B', 'n neighbours') or a bond angle (DEGREES in a sentence that names an angle, cis, trans or an A-B-C triplet, in a clause not about a direction, a cell radius, a cone, an axis, a tilt or a family, nor an ideal or reference value) asserted without a window in Angstrom in its sentence or in another sentence that names no element or every element the quoting sentence names (reading.js windowsIn: a range in A, a filled [lo, hi] A, a cutoff 'within x A', a range after 'window'; its top at least 1 A), once find_gr_peaks or compute_bond_angles counted a shell; the finding names this question's windows. The coordination check reads 'n A per B' as B's count of A (PER_COUNT) and a clause stating the whole shell's window (top within 0.05 A, WINDOW_MATCH_A, starting no later than its onset) as a claim about the shell; a clause stating another window is the user's, as before. The cross-check (src/llm/context/shells.js averageStructureBonds, averageShellCheck, AVERAGE_SHELL_REACH_A = SPLIT_SHELL_REACH_A): find_gr_peaks' first_shell.average_structure_d_A (the shortest and longest bond between site means) and a warning when a bond lies outside the window by more than the first peak's FWHM, 'check the window before using it' as method (arm C reads the reading alone); its description names it. The gate (src/llm/copilot/verification/claims.js): a polyhedra row (DISTORTED_POLYHEDRA: octahedra, tetrahedra, polyhedra; an octahedral, tetrahedral or polyhedral distortion) backed by anyOf('polyhedral_distortion', 'analyze_clusters'), the clusters row keeping the cluster nouns (DISTORTED_CLUSTERS), and anyOf asking for the first analysis the turn offers (before, a row whose first tool was not offered was never unmet); EVIDENCE_RULES says 'distorted polyhedra, polyhedral_distortion' (the binding test's gap table: polyhedra also takes analyze_clusters; 'no order' needs no polyhedral_distortion yet). analyze_clusters' method (clusterMethod, set once the tool list is built): finite clusters only; a corner-sharing polyhedron or another extended network has no finite clusters for its null, and polyhedral_distortion is named only where the run offers it. Model-visible: the system prompt +44 characters in every tools variant; find_gr_peaks' description +69 and its Demo Ta-Se result 856 -> 892 characters; analyze_clusters' description with its method +118; the dock's worst turn +100 tokens, arm B's on dev-fit-unconverged +99 (the 48k headroom 7,211 and 10,010; contextBudget.test.js pins).
